threat_event: Ransomware is pushed through the remote management platform to agency-hosted servers (including AG-02 CJI systems) and into the company network, halting managed agencies and threatening the ACMC
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SYS-10 holds standing domain administrator credentials for 9 agencies; engineers use push MFA; SYS-10 sessions are not recorded or monitored; a jump path reaches the landing zone
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-10; agency-hosted servers at AG-02 and AG-08 to AG-14; SYS-04; BP-09, BP-10, BP-01
sp800_53_controls: AC-17; IA-2; IA-5; MA-4; SI-4; AC-6
regulatory_driver: N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 MA-4, IA-5, Appendix H); Fla. Stat. 282.3185 (agency reporting)
existing_controls: EDR on engineer laptops; MDR for the identity provider; agency firewalls
treatment_plan: Vault and rotate agency credentials through the privileged access gateway; phishing-resistant keys for managed services; session recording and SIEM onboarding for SYS-10; remove the jump path into the landing zone; managed services ransomware tabletop with AG-02
exposure_estimate_usd: $4M-$10M (agency outages, response, contract claims; insurance limit $15M)

threat_event: Ransomware or destructive attack on ACMC production through a compromised cloud administrator session encrypts or deletes tenant data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Recovery of a full tenant takes 14 hours against the 8-hour RTO; region B failover untested; document storage not in the vault
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; SYS-02; SYS-03; BP-01 to BP-06
regulatory_driver: Contract (SP 800-53 Moderate); N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 CP-9); N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 sec. 4 CP-9)
existing_controls: Phishing-resistant keys and just-in-time elevation for cloud administrators; write-once vault in a separate account and region; MDR
treatment_plan: Contingency plan rewrite; document storage in the vault; timed restore of each regulated tenant twice a year; region B failover exercise
exposure_estimate_usd: $2M-$5M (service credits at cap, response, contract risk)

threat_event: Theft of FTI, CJI, benefits, or motor vehicle data from the ACMC for extortion (double extortion)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Production egress open to any HTTPS destination; no alert on large exports from regulated tenants; application audit logs not in the SIEM
existing_controls: Encryption with customer-managed keys; FTI enclave isolation; MDR on the control plane
treatment_plan: Egress allow-list; export alerts; application audit events to the SIEM
exposure_estimate_usd: $5M-$12M (up to 3.1 million individuals; agency notices, counsel, forensics, credit monitoring, contract claims)

threat_event: A CJIS or IRS Safeguards review finds staff with CJI or FTI access who are not fully screened, leading to suspended access or contract action
threat_source: State CJIS Systems Agency audit; IRS Office of Safeguards review
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 15 of 186 CJI staff and 3 of 64 FTI staff hold access with screening pending; certifications missing
affected_asset_or_process: PS-3 population; AG-01, AG-02, AG-39 tenants and AG-02 managed systems
regulatory_driver: N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 PS-3; Appendix H); N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 sec. 2.C.3; Exhibit 7 I(2))
existing_controls: Fingerprint-based checks and investigations through agencies for 171 and 61 staff
treatment_plan: Remove access for the 18 staff until screening completes; screening gate in provisioning (STD-10)
exposure_estimate_usd: $1M-$15M (contract suspension risk for AG-01 and AG-02)

threat_event: An employee browses FTI, CJI, or motor vehicle records without a work reason and it goes undetected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No review or analytics of record views and searches in regulated tenants; support staff read access by default
existing_controls: Role-based access; signed penalty notices and Security Addendum certifications; sanctions policy
treatment_plan: Weekly access analytics with referral rules; tenant-scoped support access; insider runbook (P08)
exposure_estimate_usd: $250K-$2M (agency reporting, IRC 7431 claims against the agency, DPPA $2,500 liquidated damages per person)

threat_event: Recovery of regulated tenants exceeds the 8-hour contract RTO after data corruption or loss
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Largest tenant restore took 14 hours; no rebuild runbook for the whole platform
existing_controls: Point-in-time recovery; quarterly single-tenant restore tests
treatment_plan: Parallel restore design; timed restores twice a year; rebuild runbook

threat_event: A CJIS audit finds CJI transmitted with modules that are not FIPS 140-3 certified after 2026-09-21
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Message-switch connectors for AG-02 and AG-39 and SYS-10 agents not in validated mode
existing_controls: Web ingress and AG-01 path already on certified modules
treatment_plan: Switch connectors before 2026-09-21; module inventory

threat_event: Account takeover of a managed services engineer through MFA fatigue or phishing gives an attacker administrator access to agency systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Push MFA for managed services and support staff; standing credentials in SYS-10
existing_controls: Number matching on push; conditional access (U.S. only, compliant device)
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant keys for all staff with access to agency systems or regulated data

threat_event: Caseworkers accept wrong AI eligibility suggestions (automation bias), causing wrongful denials or delays
threat_source: AI model error and human over-reliance
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No monitoring of acceptance of wrong suggestions; no review-first design
treatment_plan: Review-first design; monthly QC sample; adverse-suggestion review (P10 conditions)

threat_event: The AI assistant performs worse for some groups of applicants (language, age, disability)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No subgroup testing since launch
existing_controls: Pre-launch review on English documents only
treatment_plan: Stratified bias test before AG-44 go-live and quarterly

threat_event: Colorado SB26-189 developer duties are not met before AG-44 go-live, leading to enforcement or contract breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No developer documentation package; no process for notice of material updates
treatment_plan: Developer documentation and update notice process before go-live (P10)

threat_event: A vendor with agency data or system access is breached and the company is not told in time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 13 of 22 vendors not reviewed in 12 months; no notice terms in the SYS-10 contract
regulatory_driver: N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 Exhibit 7 I(8)); N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 SA-9)
treatment_plan: Tiered vendor reviews for all 22 (STD-03); notice terms at renewal

threat_event: The remote management platform vendor is compromised and pushes malicious updates to every managed agency server
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SYS-10 agents run with system rights on 410 servers; vendor not reviewed since 2023
treatment_plan: Vendor review and SOC 2 report; restrict agent rights; ability to disable agents centrally

threat_event: Loss of cloud region A stops the ACMC longer than the contract RTO
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Region B application build needs manual steps; failover never tested
existing_controls: Database replicas in region B; vault in region B
treatment_plan: Scripted region B build; annual failover exercise

threat_event: A compromised pipeline or open-source dependency inserts malicious code into the ACMC
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large dependency tree; pipeline secrets reachable by 180 engineers in non-production
existing_controls: Signed images verified at deployment; SBOM; dependency scanning; two approvals
treatment_plan: Pipeline hardening review; build provenance attestation

threat_event: An authorization defect lets one agency's user see another agency's records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Multi-tenant shared clusters for municipal tenants
existing_controls: Tenant ID enforced in every query; penetration test 2026-03
treatment_plan: Automated cross-tenant tests in the pipeline

threat_event: Data of a former customer is breached after the contract ended because archive copies were never deleted
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Archive and backup copies for 3 former municipal customers still held
treatment_plan: Delete and certify; extend the procedure to archives

threat_event: The company tells an agency too late to meet its CJIS, IRS, or state reporting clock
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Out-of-state clocks (AG-39, State C) not mapped; managed services engineers not trained to report
regulatory_driver: N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 IR-6); N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 sec. 1.8.4); Fla. Stat. 501.171(6)(a)
existing_controls: 1-hour rule in POL-03; notification matrix; 2025 tabletop
treatment_plan: Map out-of-state clocks; agency tabletop; managed services training
exposure_estimate_usd: $250K-$2M (agency breach of its own duty; contract claims)

threat_event: An incident cannot be scoped because application and SYS-10 logs are missing or short-lived, forcing broad notification
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Application audit logs kept 1 year in the database and not in the SIEM; SYS-10 logs kept 90 days
regulatory_driver: N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 sec. 4 AU-11); N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 AU-11)
treatment_plan: Application and SYS-10 logs to the SIEM and archive

threat_event: GovRAMP Authorized status is not reached by 2027-06-30, and the State B contracts are lost
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: High POA&M items overlap the GovRAMP control set
treatment_plan: GovRAMP plan tied to the POA&M; assessment booked for 2027 Q1

threat_event: The first SOC 2 Type 2 report has qualified opinions or many exceptions, and AG-03 or AG-01 do not renew
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Controls that are new or changing during the observation period
treatment_plan: Readiness plan (P09); start the period only when controls are operating

threat_event: Phishing compromises a delivery consultant mailbox holding agency data from implementations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Agency data sometimes exchanged by email during migrations
existing_controls: Secure transfer tool; phishing simulations (5.9%); MFA
treatment_plan: Mailbox data discovery and retention rule for migration files

threat_event: A lost or stolen laptop exposes cached agency data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Laptops travel to agency sites
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption; remote wipe; USB blocked
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Chief Operating Officer: encryption makes the data unreadable

threat_event: A hurricane closes the headquarters or delivery center and disrupts support and operations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Both offices in Florida
existing_controls: Remote work for all staff; cloud-hosted systems; staff in 9 states
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Chief Operating Officer: remote work covers loss of an office

threat_event: A denial-of-service attack blocks agency users during a tax or benefits deadline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Public sign-in endpoints
existing_controls: Provider DDoS protection; WAF rate limits
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Chief Operating Officer: provider protection is adequate

threat_event: An identity provider outage locks administrators out during an incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single identity provider for workforce
treatment_plan: Add break-glass to the FTI enclave and SYS-10

threat_event: Recovery of the FTI enclave stalls because only 6 screened administrators may work on it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Small screened group; no cross-trained backup in another shift
treatment_plan: Screen 2 more administrators; enclave recovery drill

threat_event: A known vulnerability on an agency server managed by the company is not patched within CJIS timelines and is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 of 10 sampled critical updates on AG-02 servers installed after 15 days; 12 agency servers out of support
treatment_plan: Per-agency patch tracking with CJIS timelines; agency risk acceptance for unsupported servers

threat_event: Delivery consultants keep tenant access after their projects close and misuse or mishandle data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tenant access reviewed once a year; no removal at project close
regulatory_driver: N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 AC-2(3)); N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 sec. 4 AC-2)
treatment_plan: Quarterly tenant reviews; automatic removal at project close

threat_event: Production data reaches non-production unmasked
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pressure to reproduce defects
existing_controls: Masking pipeline; guardrail blocks snapshot sharing to non-production
treatment_plan: Quarterly data discovery scan of non-production

threat_event: Engineers paste source code, secrets, or agency data into the AI coding assistant
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Coding assistant adopted without security review
existing_controls: Secrets scanning in the pipeline; enterprise license
treatment_plan: Security review; enterprise data terms; no agency data rule (STD-05)

threat_event: The public records redaction assistant misses an exempt personal identifier and a city releases it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Recall below target for handwritten and scanned pages
regulatory_driver: Contract; law of each state where the agency sits
treatment_plan: Recall testing per document type; clear limits in the user guide

threat_event: Applicant data sent to the managed model service is retained or used for training
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Only the provider's standard terms apply
existing_controls: Service within the provider FedRAMP Moderate authorization
treatment_plan: Signed data-use and no-training terms

threat_event: Instructions hidden in an uploaded document change the AI assistant's output (prompt injection)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Document text passed to the model without filtering
treatment_plan: Input filtering and labeling; injection test set in each release

threat_event: FTI in AG-01 case notes copied to the analytics service outside the enclave is treated as an unreported spillage
threat_source: IRS Office of Safeguards via AG-01
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Note fields not tagged as FTI; nightly export since 2025-04; 14 analysts without investigations had access
treatment_plan: Purge copies; disclose to the AG-01 disclosure officer; tag notes as FTI; exclude from exports

threat_event: The AG-39 interface runs without a written interconnection agreement, and a State B audit finds it
threat_source: State B CJIS Systems Agency audit
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No agreement; State B CSA requirements not mapped
treatment_plan: Sign the agreement; map State B requirements

threat_event: An emergency change in the FTI enclave made by one administrator breaks service or weakens controls
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 enclave administrators can approve and deploy alone; 2 of 9 emergency changes not reviewed
treatment_plan: Second approver for all enclave changes; review within 2 business days

threat_event: Privileged sessions on agency systems cannot be reconstructed, so the company cannot show what it did during an incident or audit
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No session recording; SYS-10 logs kept 90 days
treatment_plan: Session recording and 1-year retention

threat_event: A misconfigured agency federation lets an agency identity provider assert roles beyond its tenant
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Federation mapping maintained by hand
existing_controls: Tenant ID enforced in the application regardless of claims
treatment_plan: Automated federation mapping tests

threat_event: Credential stuffing takes over municipal local accounts without MFA
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 6 municipal tenants without MFA
treatment_plan: Enforce MFA for local accounts

threat_event: A customer-managed key for the FTI enclave or regulated tier is deleted or disabled, making data unrecoverable
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Key administration inside production roles
existing_controls: Key deletion waiting period; key administrators separate from database administrators
treatment_plan: Alert on key policy changes; quarterly key recovery check

threat_event: Staff overdue for FTI recertification keep access, and an IRS review finds it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 7 staff overdue
treatment_plan: Suspend access at expiry automatically

threat_event: The planned 2027 acquisition brings in systems and staff that do not meet agency terms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No security due diligence standard for acquisitions
treatment_plan: Security due diligence checklist; no connection before assessment

threat_event: Telephone or contact center outage prevents the 1-hour agency notices
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One carrier
existing_controls: Mobile phones and the printed contact list
treatment_plan: Second carrier for the support line

threat_event: A web application attack (for example injection) is used against ACMC public endpoints
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large public attack surface
existing_controls: WAF; static and dynamic testing; annual penetration test
treatment_plan: Continue; add authenticated dynamic scans of each release

threat_event: The MDR provider fails to escalate a high-severity alert in time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Escalation measured only by the provider
treatment_plan: Monthly escalation tests and service reviews

threat_event: Broad analyst access to the analytics service exposes regulated tenant data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14 analysts can query all tenants in SYS-08
treatment_plan: Row-level tenant security for analysts; quarterly review

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects payroll or vendor payments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Payment change requests by email
treatment_plan: Dual approval in the finance system

threat_event: A departing employee takes agency data or source code
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large workforce turnover (142 terminations a year)
treatment_plan: Data loss alerts on bulk downloads before termination dates

threat_event: The SYS-10 automation API token, found in a wiki readable by 212 staff, is used to run scripts on every managed agency server (found in P07)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Token stored in plain text in a shared wiki page; no rotation; full script rights
treatment_plan: Token revoked; scoped tokens in the secrets manager; wiki secrets scan; review SYS-10 logs for use

threat_event: AG-39 and other out-of-state work is run under Florida-centric procedures and misses State B requirements
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: State B CSA requirements and State B and C breach laws not mapped
regulatory_driver: N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 Appendix H); law of each state
existing_controls: Contracts reviewed by counsel at signing
treatment_plan: State requirements map maintained by counsel

threat_event: Agency records are kept longer than contracts allow because retention rules differ by agency
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Retention set per contract by hand
treatment_plan: Retention jobs per tenant
